title: ICE Planning $100M 'Nightmare' Domestic Spy Program
title_zh: ICE计划斥资1亿美元实施“噩梦”国内间谍项目

paragraphs.en: This article was featured in the Daily Prospect newsletter. Sign up for it here.
paragraphs.zh: 本文曾刊载于《Daily Prospect》新闻通讯。请点击此处订阅。

paragraphs.en: Immigration and Customs Enforcement is fast-tracking a $100 million domestic surveillance program to put 142 intelligence agents in more than two dozen cities and the District of Columbia, in what contracting and surveillance experts said would be a significant expansion of the agency’s ability to reach into private lives.
paragraphs.zh: 移民与海关执法局正在快速推进一项价值1亿美元的国内监控计划，将在二十多个城市及哥伦比亚特区部署142名情报智能体。合同与监控领域的专家表示，这将显著扩展该机构介入私人生活的能力。

paragraphs.en: The new program is called the Enforcement and Removal Operations Overwatch and National Security Enforcement, or ERO ONE, described in documents posted last month on federal procurement websites.
paragraphs.zh: 该项目名为「执法与遣返行动监察及国家安全执法」（Enforcement and Removal Operations Overwatch and National Security Enforcement），简称 ERO ONE，相关内容在上个月发布于联邦采购网站上的一份文件中有所描述。

paragraphs.en: Under the program, agents would analyze classified and unclassified information to identify “trends, patterns, relationships, threats, and intelligence gaps,” and provide ICE with briefings for Enforcement and Removal Operation missions, according to a statement of work published on September 18 . A forecasting document published a week earlier said that the solicitation will likely be released on December 10. Intelligence contracting experts said the timeline suggests ICE will award the contract around February.
paragraphs.zh: 根据一份于9月18日发布的工作说明书，在该项目下，智能体将分析涉密与非涉密信息，以识别“趋势、模式、关系、威胁和情报缺口”，并为移民与海关执法局（ICE）的执法与驱逐行动任务提供简报。 一份提前一周发布的预测文件显示，该招标很可能于12月10日发布。 情报承包领域的专家表示，这一时间线表明ICE将在2月左右授予该合同。

sents.zh: 根据一份于9月18日发布的工作说明书，在该项目下，智能体将分析涉密与非涉密信息，以识别“趋势、模式、关系、威胁和情报缺口”，并为移民与海关执法局（ICE）的执法与驱逐行动任务提供简报。

paragraphs.en: “It looks dangerously like the construction of an internal spying agency,” said Jay Stanley, senior policy analyst with the American Civil Liberties Union’s Speech, Privacy, and Technology Project, who has written extensively on immigration agencies’ mass surveillance. “It’s a nightmare in the making.”
paragraphs.zh: “这看起来非常像是在建立一个内部间谍机构，”美国公民自由联盟言论、隐私与技术项目高级政策分析师杰伊·斯坦利（Jay Stanley）说，他就移民机构的大规模监控写过大量文章。“这正在酝酿成一场噩梦。”

paragraphs.en: It’s also a weapon that the government will likely use against not only undocumented immigrants, but everyone else, too. That includes political enemies, intelligence experts said. Speaking with the Prospect on Monday as news broke that the Trump regime had raided progressive Minnesota Rep. Ilhan Omar’s D.C. home, former military intelligence analyst Michael Wriston said that “you’d expect to see more of this” under ERO ONE.
paragraphs.zh: 它也是政府可能会用来对付的武器——不仅针对无证移民，也针对其他所有人。 情报专家表示，这包括政治对手。 周一，特朗普政权突袭明尼苏达州进步派众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔的消息传出之际，这位众议员接受了《展望》杂志的采访。 前军事情报分析员迈克尔·里斯顿表示，在 ERO ONE 行动之下，“你预计会看到更多此类情况”。

sents.en: Speaking with the Prospect on Monday as news broke that the Trump regime had raided progressive Minnesota Rep.
sents.zh: 周一，特朗普政权突袭明尼苏达州进步派众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔的消息传出之际，这位众议员接受了《展望》杂志的采访。

sents.en: Ilhan Omar’s D.C. home, former military intelligence analyst Michael Wriston said that “you’d expect to see more of this” under ERO ONE.
sents.zh: 前军事情报分析员迈克尔·里斯顿表示，在 ERO ONE 行动之下，“你预计会看到更多此类情况”。

paragraphs.en: “Not just necessarily sitting members of Congress, but anyone, and especially members of the immigrant community,” Wriston said. “No one is safe. No one.”
paragraphs.zh: “不仅仅是现任国会议员，而是任何人，尤其是移民社区的成员，”里斯顿（Wriston）说。“没有人是安全的。没有人。”

paragraphs.en: THE PLAN DOES NOT SPECIFY WHAT OR WHOM ICE is looking for with this increased spying capability. But one of the components that caused former intelligence contractors’ concern was that ERO ONE agents will analyze both classified and nonclassified information to produce “network, link and relationship” analyses. That type of analysis involves researching not only a target, but also every other person to whom they’re connected, including household members, family members, friends, acquaintances, or the person with whom they carpool to work.
paragraphs.zh: 该计划并未具体说明ICE利用这一增强的监视能力在寻找什么或寻找谁。 但令前情报承包商担忧的组成部分之一是，ERO ONE智能体将分析机密和非机密信息，以生成“网络、关联和关系”分析。 这类分析不仅涉及调查目标本人，还涉及调查与其有联系的每一个其他人，包括家庭成员、亲戚、朋友、熟人，或与其拼车上班的人。

sents.en: THE PLAN DOES NOT SPECIFY WHAT OR WHOM ICE is looking for with this increased spying capability.
sents.zh: 该计划并未具体说明ICE利用这一增强的监视能力在寻找什么或寻找谁。

sents.en: But one of the components that caused former intelligence contractors’ concern was that ERO ONE agents will analyze both classified and nonclassified information to produce “network, link and relationship” analyses.
sents.zh: 但令前情报承包商担忧的组成部分之一是，ERO ONE智能体将分析机密和非机密信息，以生成“网络、关联和关系”分析。

sents.en: That type of analysis involves researching not only a target, but also every other person to whom they’re connected, including household members, family members, friends, acquaintances, or the person with whom they carpool to work.

paragraphs.en: According to the statement of work, contractors will be tasked with conducting analytical research “to identify and assess relationships among individuals, organizations, locations, events, activities, data points, and other entities.” They will review information to identify “known, reported, or potential relationships; recurring patterns; organizational structures; associations; areas of convergence; temporal or geographic connections; and other linkages relevant to the assigned intelligence requirement.” Contractors will then “evaluate the significance and reliability” of the relationships and “prepare link charts, network diagrams, timelines, analytical summaries, written assessments, or other related products” for ICE to use.
paragraphs.zh: 根据工作说明书，承包商将承担分析研究任务，“以识别和评估个人、组织、地点、事件、活动、数据点及其他实体之间的关系”。他们将审查信息，以识别“已知的、已报告的或潜在的关系；反复出现的模式；组织结构；关联；交汇点；时间或地理上的联系；以及其他与所指派情报需求相关的联结”。随后，承包商将“评估这些关系的重要性和可靠性”，并“制作关联图表、网络图、时间线、分析摘要、书面评估报告或其他相关产品”，供移民与海关执法局（ICE）使用。

paragraphs.en: Military intelligence agents compile the same type of research, Wriston said. He knows because he did that job.
paragraphs.zh: 里斯顿说，军事情报智能体也会整理同类研究资料。 他知道这一点，因为他本人做过这份工作。

paragraphs.en: “We’ve seen this time and time again. It’s the imperial boomerang,” said Wriston, who is also a data journalist and the founder of ICE watchdog group Project Salt Box , where he reported on ERO ONE the day the first document went live and has written about it since. “These are the kinds of things that happened in Afghanistan, Iraq, Yemen, Syria, for years. Now that methodology is being brought into the ICE space.”
paragraphs.zh: “这样的事情我们已经一次又一次地见过。 这就是帝国回旋镖，”同样身为数据记者、ICE监督组织Project Salt Box创始人的Wriston说道。自第一份文件上线当天起，他就开始报道ERO ONE，并持续撰写相关内容。“这些是多年来在阿富汗、伊拉克、也门、叙利亚发生过的事情。 如今这套方法正被引入ICE领域。”

paragraphs.en: Federal documents likewise do not detail the specific sources of information agents will analyze, only that all agents must possess previously awarded active top secret clearance, with eligibility to access Sensitive Compartmented Information. That’s a type of information that must be accessed through certain formal control systems managed by the Director of National Intelligence, a position held by Trump ally Jay Clayton. The agents will not make any decisions about what to do with the information they compile.
paragraphs.zh: 联邦文件同样没有详细说明智能体将分析的具体信息来源，只是规定所有智能体必须持有此前已授予的有效绝密许可，并具备访问敏感分类信息（Sensitive Compartmented Information）的资格。 这类信息必须通过由国家情报总监管理的某些正式控制系统才能访问，该职位目前由特朗普的盟友杰伊·克莱顿（Jay Clayton）担任。 智能体将不会对如何处理其收集的信息做出任何决定。

paragraphs.en: Wriston said that except for the fact that ICE officials are trying to make immigration a matter of national security, it’s unclear why they need this program when they already have the Homeland Security Investigations unit, which conducted the raid on Omar’s house, to research targets. His immediate worry, he said, is that the program will make it easier for the government to find terrified immigrants hiding at home because they think they’ll be safe there.
paragraphs.zh: 里斯顿表示，除了ICE官员试图将移民问题变成国家安全事务这一点之外，目前还不清楚他们既然已经有国土安全调查部门（该部门曾突袭奥马尔的家）来研究目标，为什么还需要这个项目。 他说，他最直接的担忧是，该项目将使政府更容易找到那些因为待在家里就以为安全的、惊恐万分而躲在家中的移民。

paragraphs.en: Details in the document, and the rapid timeline, show that the Trump administration intends to use the program immediately, said Brian Murphy, a government contractor who worked for 25 years with ICE parent agency DHS. It’s rare for the government to only want workers with top secret clearance, he said.
paragraphs.zh: 曾在美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）的上级机构国土安全部工作过25年的政府承包商布莱恩·墨菲表示，文件中的细节以及紧迫的时间线表明，特朗普政府打算立即启用该计划。 他说，政府通常很少只想要拥有绝密许可的工作人员。

sents.zh: 他说，政府通常很少只想要拥有绝密许可的工作人员。

paragraphs.en: “I’ve only seen it when there is an imminent need to work on something right now,” he told the Prospect . “Trump has two years in office. He can’t wait … they want to get rolling on this immediately.”
paragraphs.zh: 他在接受《展望》采访时说：“我只有在必须立刻着手处理某件事的紧迫需求时，才见过这种情况。特朗普有两年任期。 他等不了……他们想立刻开始推进这件事。”

paragraphs.en: The program description is so broad that Murphy said he thinks the goal goes beyond targeting immigrants. “I think it’s darker than that,” because the agency could use the intelligence to attack people with identities and views the Trump regime doesn’t like. “The question for DHS is, what is the threat they’re trying to go after?”
paragraphs.zh: 墨菲表示，该项目描述过于宽泛，他认为其目标不仅仅是针对移民。“我认为事情比这更黑暗，”因为该机构可能利用这些情报来攻击那些身份和观点不被特朗普政权所喜欢的人。“国土安全部需要回答的问题是：他们想要追查的威胁究竟是什么？”

paragraphs.en: “It looks dangerously like the construction of an internal spying agency.”
paragraphs.zh: “这看起来危险地像是在建立一个内部间谍机构。”

paragraphs.en: The federal government can easily change who qualifies as a threat and produce data that backs up the reasoning, Murphy said, and used as an example annual Homeland Threat Assessments. In 2020, Secretary of Homeland Security Chad Wolf identified white supremacist extremists as “the most persistent and lethal threat in the Homeland.” But by last year, that threat had disappeared from the report , except to appear once in a glossary of terms. The rest of the report focused heavily on Trump administration priorities as national security threats, including immigrants crossing the border with Mexico and transnational criminal organizations.
paragraphs.zh: 墨菲说，联邦政府可以轻易改变谁符合威胁的认定标准，并拿出支持其理由的数据，他还以年度《国土威胁评估》为例。 2020年，国土安全部部长查德·沃尔夫将白人至上主义极端分子认定为“国土面临的最持久、最致命的威胁”。但到去年，这一威胁已从报告中消失，只在一个术语表里出现过一次。 报告的其余部分则重点将特朗普政府的优先事项列为国家安全威胁，包括跨越与墨西哥边境的移民以及跨国犯罪组织。

sents.en: The rest of the report focused heavily on Trump administration priorities as national security threats, including immigrants crossing the border with Mexico and transnational criminal organizations.
sents.zh: 报告的其余部分则重点将特朗普政府的优先事项列为国家安全威胁，包括跨越与墨西哥边境的移民以及跨国犯罪组织。

paragraphs.en: In addition, the murders of Renee Good and Alex Pretti have shown how the government views protesters against ICE abductions as an abiding threat. In a national security directive known as NSPM-7, President Trump identified anti-fascist protesters as domestic terrorists and proposed an architecture to disrupt and counter dissent.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，蕾妮·古德（Renee Good）和亚历克斯·普雷蒂（Alex Pretti）的被杀事件表明，政府如何将抗议ICE绑架行为的示威者视为一种长期威胁。 在一份编号为 NSPM-7 的国家安全指令中，特朗普总统将反法西斯抗议者认定为国内恐怖分子，并提出了一套瓦解和打击异见的架构。

paragraphs.en: “If you want to draw a narrative that the real threat to America is whatever you want it to be, you can very easily do that. You just stop gathering intel on militias,” Murphy said. “It’s like any other police state. If you ask it to find something to make my opponents the enemy, well, you can do that.”
paragraphs.zh: “如果你想描绘这样一种叙事，即美国面临的真正威胁可以随你所愿，你很容易就能做到。 你只需要停止收集有关民兵组织的情报，”墨菲说，“这和任何其他警察国家没什么两样。 如果你要求它去找些东西来把我的对手塑造成敌人，那么你就可以做到。”

paragraphs.en: Legal liability should be a major concern for anyone who bids on the ERO ONE contract, Murphy said, because it’s unclear whether the information they’d be charged with accessing had been gathered legally. He added, “It’s very, very concerning that they’re fast-tracking this.”
paragraphs.zh: 墨菲说，对于任何投标 ERO ONE 合同的人来说，法律责任都应该是一个主要担忧，因为他们将被指控访问的信息是否是通过合法途径获取的尚不清楚。 他补充道：“他们正在快速推进这件事，这一点非常、非常令人担忧。”

paragraphs.en: Stanley, the ACLU analyst, noted that immigration officials across agencies have been using an excessive amount of surveillance tools for years, including their “Stingray” cell tower simulators , automatic license plate readers, and tools that track location from cellphones . They use a facial recognition and biometric collection app called Mobile Fortify, a Palantir app called ImmigrationOS to track immigrants’ movements , and buy data from LexisNexis to identify someone’s family and work history . ERO ONE would draw on all of that information, plus an expanded group of sources to reach into the private lives of anyone it wants, intelligence experts said.
paragraphs.zh: 美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）分析师斯坦利指出，各机构的移民官员多年来一直在使用过量的监控工具，包括他们的“黄貂鱼”（Stingray）基站模拟器、自动车牌识别器，以及从手机追踪位置的工具。 他们使用一款名为 Mobile Fortify 的人脸识别和生物特征采集应用程序、一款名为 ImmigrationOS 的 Palantir 应用程序来追踪移民的行踪，并从律商联讯（LexisNexis）购买数据以识别某人的家庭和工作履历。 情报专家表示，ERO ONE 将利用所有这些信息，外加一个扩大的来源群体，以深入探查其想要的任何人的私生活。

paragraphs.en: ICE already knows its potential bidders for ERO ONE, said Diana Brozi, the procurement specialist listed on the document. She told the Prospect it was unlikely the agency would hold an industry day and declined to provide further information.
paragraphs.zh: 文件中列明的采购专员戴安娜·布罗齐表示，ICE 已经知晓 ERO ONE 项目的潜在竞标者。 她告诉《展望报》，该机构不太可能举办行业日活动，并拒绝提供进一步的信息。

paragraphs.en: DHS did not respond to a request for information or comment on the claim that the program could be used to spy on political enemies.
paragraphs.zh: 国土安全部（DHS）未回应关于该计划可能被用于监视政治对手这一说法的信息请求或置评请求。

paragraphs.en: Whitney Curry Wimbish is a staff writer at The American Prospect. She previously worked in the Financial Times newsletters division, The Cambodia Daily in Phnom Penh, and the Herald News in New Jersey. Her work has been published in multiple outlets, including The New York Times, The Baffler, Los Angeles Review of Books, Music & Literature, North American Review, Sentient, Semafor, and elsewhere. She is a coauthor of The Majority Report’s daily newsletter and publishes short fiction in a range of literary magazines. She can be reached on Signal at wwimbish.07. More by Whitney Curry Wimbish
